C0.quote: We study computational aspects of a well-known single-winner voting rule
C0.note: Computational complexity of winner determination for the Schulze voting method.

C1.quote: one can compute the set of all winners of the Schulze method
C1.note: All main results are algorithms and fine-grained conditional lower bounds.

C2.2.quote: single-winner voting rule defined on (weak) ordinal preference ballots
C2.2.note: The rule is defined on weak orders. Several main results (Theorems 1.1, 4.1, 5.3; Propositions 3.2, 3.3) take the weighted majority graph as input: 'When the input is the weighted majority graph'. Linear orders appear only as special instances in the lower-bound constructions, not as the input format.
